stage: Parsed selection before option/identity/path validation or public startup
state: Declared input/output cases; native execution recorded separately
setupEncoding: Flattened catalog property paths, canonical severity names and format/stream/detail tokens; numeric values retain typed domains. The fixture caller supplies host.environmentName as setup only when setup.EnvironmentName is unspecified.
hostStateScope: Controlled fixture context is preserved, not injected into Core. Actual child terminal/debugger state is observed separately; a compiled configuration-call guard checks for forbidden ambient-state reads.
